label: جود — نجدية
ref_text: الله يعطيك العافية. رقم جوالك المسجل عندنا وش يكون؟ عشان أقدر أتحقق من هويتك
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_mix_v3/wavs/c1530756413e.wav (id najdi_v3_c1530756413e, the same clip as najdi_v4_c1530756413e: in the test split of najdi_mix_v3 and of najdi_v4, so the shipped najdi_v4_ft checkpoint never trained on it)
notes: Joud ('Joud - Saudi Gentle & Warm', a synthesiser voice), the Najdi female support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (9,017 of her clips, 11.6 h, nearly all Najdi). An agent asking for the caller's number, at her natural pace. Picked on 2026-10-01 from her held-out clips of 5-9 s. Re-checked on 2026-10-04 with najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250 against the ten best of 194 such clips, each cloned on eight unseen sentences: the best alternative was within noise of this one (similarity +0.001 +/- 0.009, UTMOS +0.071 +/- 0.036), so this clip stays.

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
